description: Welcome to this gem of a home situated in the coveted Skyline Terrace neighborhood of Mill Valley. This elegant newer turnkey home has been meticulously maintained over the years. Enjoy the open concept and inviting floor plan. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining room and sunken living room. Perfect for entertaining. Relax in front of the gas fireplace or unwind on the sunny deck which is just off the living room and perfect for outdoor dining. The spacious primary suite below has a large en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub, stall shower, dual vanity, walk-in closet and a private deck. The two bedrooms on the bottom level share a full bathroom and a third deck. Additional highlights include vaulted ceilings, wide plank hardwood flooring in the kitchen & dining room, stainless steel appliances, Corian kitchen countertop, recessed lighting, wet bar, several skylights and plantation shutters. The attached 2 car garage is spacious with additional storage and an EV charger. Conveniently located and not far from the Good Earth natural food market and the many popular restaurants in Tam Junction. It borders the Golden Gate National Recreation area, and the Homestead biking/hiking trail located just up the hill. Not far is access to the infamous Dipsea Trail, Muir and Stinson beaches as well as the 101 freeway. Highly rated and award-winning Mill Valley school district. This is an exceptional must-see opportunity!
